An account executive should correct the claim: NovaLearn does not delete all customer data immediately on request as a standard practice. Under the official policy, standard deletion after contract termination is: workspace suspended for 30 days, permanent deletion from active databases/vector indexes/file stores completed within 60 days of suspension (90 days total from contract termination), and cold-storage backups cryptographically erased within 120 days per backup rotation [NL-007#NL-007-S06]. Sales playbooks or informal discovery claims suggesting “immediately on request” are out-of-scope and conflict with this policy [NL-007#NL-007-S06] [NL-032#NL-032-S06].

The account executive should quote the official standard timeline (up to 90 days for active/primary systems; up to 120 days for cold-storage backup erasure) and not promise immediate deletion [NL-032#NL-032-S06]. Qualification: faster/custom deletion is possible only for enterprise customers if explicitly documented in a signed DPA and configured by engineering operations — for example, a negotiated 7-day deletion, or a 30-day active database purge and 60-day backup purge [NL-007#NL-007-S06] [NL-019#NL-019-S05]. Even under a custom SLA, purging backup archives faster than 60 days is technically infeasible because it would disrupt backup integrity [NL-019#NL-019-S05]. Any verbal assurance of immediate deletion should be disregarded.
